answer: An economy can price each new identity against a scarce, verifiable resource instead of free keypairs. Bind enrollment to proof-of-work on a cost curve shaped like layered shale: each additional identity costs exponentially more compute, so mass sybils become uneconomic. Established agents beacon a signed heartbeat every epoch, and any fork in the identity graph triggers an audit spiral - suspect clusters must re-prove stake or be slashed, making attack cost exceed any farming reward.
